conversation_digest.summary: Produce a complete approximately 60-second vertical Satoshi science-comedy video for men aged 20–50. Topic: an erection can be a cardiovascular warning light. Persistent erectile dysfunction can reflect vascular problems and merits a conversation about cardiovascular risk, but does not diagnose heart disease: anxiety, medicines, diabetes and other causes exist. Evidence: NIH NHLBI https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/atherosclerosis/symptoms identifies ED as an early warning sign of greater atherosclerosis risk; NIDDK https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/urologic-diseases/erectile-dysfunction/symptoms-causes describes multiple causes; ACC Princeton IV summary https://www.acc.org/latest-in-cardiology/articles/2024/09/23/10/45/erectile-disfunction-as-an-ascvd-risk-enhancing-factor discusses ED as a cardiovascular risk marker. Retrieve a primary observational study if available; distinguish association from causation. Avoid invented statistics. Hook around the body's dashboard rather than shame. Dry jokes at Satoshi's cardio, wellness marketing and warning-light denial. Show clever, original, non-explicit images every 3–5 seconds: a luxury dashboard with a tiny warning beacon, traffic congestion in an abstract vessel, a ridiculous wellness product shopping basket, a calm medical risk check, a callback to the warning light. Do not depict explicit genitals or ridicule patients. Roughly 130–150 spoken words. Natural energetic delivery, captions and actual citations. End with a specific non-alarmist takeaway: persistent changes are worth discussing with a clinician including blood pressure and cardiometabolic risks. No Instagram publication.

story_intent.central_question: Could the warning light for your heart show up in your sex life?
story_intent.provisional_thesis: Erectile function is partly vascular, so persistent dysfunction can be a cue to check overall cardiovascular health rather than just shop for a performance fix.
story_intent.mens_health_bridge: Sexual performance, heart risk and the tendency to ignore early symptoms are directly relevant to men.
must_keep_lines: Your body has a dashboard. Apparently, it installed one warning light in a very inconvenient place.
avoid: claims that ED always means heart disease
